intro.data: Sometimes the right step changes nothing at all. Use the Pass Through machine that returns a thing as itself.
intro.alchemy: Sometimes the right step changes nothing at all. Use the Preserve apparatus that returns a material as itself.
intro.spellcraft: Sometimes the right step changes nothing at all. Use the Echo rune that returns an essence as itself.
intro.abstract: Sometimes the right step changes nothing at all. Use the Identity process from an object back to itself.

goal.data: Place the do-nothing machine from A back to A, then reveal identity (id_A).
goal.alchemy: Place the do-nothing apparatus from A back to A, then reveal identity (id_A).
goal.spellcraft: Place the do-nothing rune from A back to A, then reveal identity (id_A).
goal.abstract: Place the identity process id_A : A → A, then reveal identity.
